prompt.zh-CN: 日常洗手时，哪项最重要？
prompt.en-US: For everyday handwashing, what matters most?

text.zh-CN: 用流动水和肥皂充分搓洗
text.en-US: Scrubbing well with running water and soap
Only staring at the faucet for three seconds

text.zh-CN: 把手放进口袋里假装干净
text.en-US: Putting hands in pockets and pretending they are clean
Washing hands with a remote control

reveal.zh-CN: 肥皂和搓洗能帮助去除污物和微生物，流动水再把它们冲走。
reveal.en-US: Soap and scrubbing help remove dirt and microbes, and running water rinses them away.

prompt.zh-CN: 判断：平时长期少睡，周末多睡一天就能完全抵消所有影响。
prompt.en-US: True or false: sleeping very little for a long time can be completely canceled out by sleeping extra on one weekend day.

reveal.zh-CN: 补觉可能缓解困倦，但长期睡眠不足的影响不一定能被一次性完全抵消。
reveal.en-US: Catch-up sleep may reduce sleepiness, but the effects of chronic sleep loss are not necessarily erased all at once.

prompt.zh-CN: 防晒霜上的 SPF 主要表示对哪类紫外线晒伤风险的防护指标？
prompt.en-US: SPF on sunscreen mainly indicates protection against sunburn risk from which ultraviolet rays?

reveal.zh-CN: SPF 主要衡量对 UVB 造成晒伤的防护，广谱防晒还会关注 UVA。
reveal.en-US: SPF mainly measures protection against UVB-related sunburn, while broad-spectrum sunscreen also addresses UVA.

prompt.zh-CN: “均衡饮食”最接近下面哪种理解？
prompt.en-US: Which statement best describes a balanced diet?

text.zh-CN: 多类食物合理搭配，避免长期单一
text.en-US: Combining multiple food groups reasonably and avoiding long-term monotony

text.zh-CN: 每天只吃同一种颜色的食物
text.en-US: Eating only one color of food every day
Anything with a nice name is healthy
A menu is balanced if it lies flat

reveal.zh-CN: 均衡强调总体结构和长期习惯，而不是某一种神奇食物。
reveal.en-US: Balance is about overall structure and long-term habits, not one magical food.

prompt.zh-CN: 运动前热身的主要目的之一是什么？
prompt.en-US: What is one main purpose of warming up before exercise?

text.zh-CN: 逐步提高身体活动状态，降低突然运动的不适风险
text.en-US: Gradually prepare the body for activity and reduce discomfort from sudden exertion

reveal.zh-CN: 热身能让心率、肌肉和关节逐步进入运动状态。
reveal.en-US: Warm-ups help heart rate, muscles, and joints transition gradually into activity.
